title: Stepper
description: A multi-step progress indicator with numbered, icon, or dot variants and horizontal/vertical orientation.

icon.description: React.ComponentType | React.ReactNode — Custom icon for the step.

completedIcon.description: React.ComponentType | React.ReactNode — Icon shown when step is completed.

errorIcon.description: React.ComponentType | React.ReactNode — Icon shown when step has an error.

tooltip.description: React.ReactNode | StepTooltipConfig — Tooltip content or configuration for the step.

onValueChange.description: (stepId: string | number) => void — Callback fired when the active step changes.

beforeStepChange.description: (nextStepId: string | number, currentStepId: string | number) => boolean — Guard callback invoked before changing steps. Return false to prevent the change.

variant.description: Visual variant of the step indicators.

activationMode.description: Whether steps activate automatically on focus or require manual activation.

isStepClickable.description: (stepId: string | number, status: StepStatus) => boolean — Determines whether a step is clickable.

getStepStatus.description: (stepId: string | number, index: number, activeIndex: number) => StepStatus — Custom function to determine step status.

showConnectors.description: Whether to show connectors between steps.

labelPosition.description: Position of step labels relative to the indicator.

completedIcon.description: React.ComponentType | React.ReactNode — Default icon for completed steps.

errorIcon.description: React.ComponentType | React.ReactNode — Default icon for error steps.

fullWidth.description: Whether the stepper expands to fill its container.

showTooltips.description: Whether to show tooltips on steps.

tooltipDefaults.description: Default tooltip configuration applied to all step tooltips.

indicatorSize.description: Override indicator size in pixels for connector alignment. Defaults: dot=12, icon=40, numbered=32.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects the user's OS setting.

unstyled.description: When true, removes all default styling.

className.description: CSS class for the root element.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the root element.

disabled.description: Whether the entire stepper is disabled.

loop.description: Whether keyboard navigation loops from last step to first.

renderStep.description: (props: StepRenderProps, defaultElement: ReactElement) => ReactNode — Custom step render function.
